estimates.t: Reserves for excess and obsolete inventory are based upon quantities on hand, projected volumes from demand forecasts, and net realizable value.

estimates.t: We are subject to ongoing business risks arising in the ordinary course of business that affect the estimation process of the carrying value of assets, the recording of liabilities, and the possibility of various loss contingencies.

estimates.name: Customer Loyalty Program
estimates.t: We have a customer loyalty program (the “Loyalty Program”) under which customers who participate in the Loyalty Program earn points based on qualifying purchases that can be redeemed for discounts on future purchases.

estimates.name: Stock-Based Compensation
